description:
STATE (2026-08-31): fix BUILT AND VERIFIED, parked at
scratchpad/fz-kdt.91.patch (144 lines, applies at d5d45a074); NOT landed --
blocked by fz-kdt.93 (return-transport recursion anchor is visit-order
decided; canonicalizing clause order perturbs visit order and flips 12/22
executables' layouts decomposed->boxed, a content change beyond
permutation = STOP).

THE FIX: EntryReachability::new sorts+dedups by body_id
(src/compiler2/semantic.rs:613), making the fact canonical at
construction; the arrival-order contains-dedupe loop in analyze_activation
(jobs/semantic.rs:158-163) is deleted in the same motion.

VERIFIED FINDINGS (builder, at d5d45a074):
- This is CANONICALIZATION, NOT a correctness fix: clause try-order lives
  in PatternDispatchPlan (first-match-wins encoded at plan construction
  from source-ordered rows); clause_ids is only a body_id->position lookup
  (ir_interp/backend.rs:565-582, jobs/native.rs:2836-2858,
  artifact.rs:498), kept in lockstep with the pruned clause vector by
  construction (jobs/artifact.rs:1650, 1673). Behavior byte-identical
  12/12 (interp + AOT, three lens fixtures).
- body_id IS source order: minted by enumerate over surface clauses
  (jobs/dispatch.rs:283); the planner enforces strictly-ascending body_id
  (dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs:881-887, NonMonotonicBodyId).
- All other consumers are set-like or index-by-id (list in build report);
  is_direct_clause() order-insensitive.
- Live arrival!=source instances at HEAD: take_drop 2/214 (List.reduce_cont/3,
  List.count/2), predicate 7/221 (List.reduce_while_cont/3), range_map 0/59.
- RED tests (in the patch): entry_reachability_names_clauses_in_source_
  order_not_arrival_order (drive-altitude, [1,0] vs [0,1]) and
  artifact_clause_ids_follow_source_order_on_the_target_fixtures.
- Gates with fix applied: lib 1511/1 -- the single fail is an IMPROVING
  pin (predicate unchanged_outputs 4->5: one fewer spurious changed-wake;
  legitimate re-pin when landing); cli 23/0 (no budget moved); matrix
  416/0; clippy+fmt clean; inventory pins hold; determinism pair green.
- NOTE: the repo holds NO stored canon dumps -- canon tests compare two
  runs of the same tree, so "re-baseline" is a no-op and layout changes
  surface only as cross-version diffs (which is how fz-kdt.93 was caught).

LAND CONDITIONS: after fz-kdt.93, re-apply the patch, confirm the canon
cross-version diff is a PURE clause_ids permutation (+ following value
numbering), re-pin the one improving lifecycle column, fresh full gate.
